content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN, critical).**

- **Investigation:** Section 20 has a single paragraph — a one-way Customer indemnity for "every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services." Searches for indemnity/defence language across the whole document turned up only incidental references (19.4, 19.5, 21.3, 29.2, 30.5) and a dangling cross-reference in 9.3 to a non-existent "Section 20.5" of infringement remedies. No Vendor indemnity exists anywhere — walk-away territory.
- **Target level:** Preferred. The fallback would require volunteering a 3× annual fees super-cap on Vendor's indemnity, which is unnecessary here because 21.3 already treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true, minimality passed):** narrowed 20.1 in place to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law, and inserted a new 20.2 carrying Vendor's defend/indemnify duty for Customer and its Affiliates covering IP infringement of Services/Deliverables, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breach, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, plus notice, control of defence, and reasonable cooperation. All ten preferred elements mapped exactly once.
